sources.observation: The large ribbed central dome has two shorter curved companions on an otherwise pale stepped theater roof.

sources.credit: Wikimedia Commons contributor, see image page
sources.observation: White marble columns, three principal doorways and the deep central arch face the plaza. The three amber dome sections rise above the carved parapets.

limitations: Sculptures, carved panels, roof panels and ornament are simplified from exterior photos. The map controls the building envelope and principal roof groups.
